title: Your Debit Card Has Zero Fraud Protection
hook: You use your debit card thinking it's the safe choice — but if someone steals your info, your bank can legally keep your money forever.
angle: Most people think debit is 'safer' because it's real money — but federal law gives debit cards dramatically weaker fraud protection than credit cards, and the reporting-deadline rules are almost unknown.
audience: Anyone who primarily uses a debit card for everyday spending (68% of Americans)
key_numbers: $0 — your max fraud liability on a credit card under federal law
$500+ — what you can legally lose on debit fraud if you report after 3 days
10 business days — how long your bank can investigate while your money stays frozen
$16 billion — annual debit card fraud in the US
68% — Americans who primarily use debit cards
